description: Main-window ACL. Survivors and why: core:default (path/event/window/app/menu/tray); core:app:allow-default-window-icon (tray icon); core:window allow-hide/show/unminimize/set-focus/destroy (close-to-tray and quit); fs:default plus exists/stat/lstat/write-text-file (conversation export; writes denied under $RESOURCE so the renderer cannot rewrite the sidecar Node then executes); dialog:default (export save, BYOM open); autostart enable/disable/is-enabled (Settings); updater check and download-and-install (About check today; install UX in 1.0 Wave 8); notification:default (memory watchdog and tray-hide); shell:allow-execute only for bundled/PATH node -v/--version (About runtime probe). Sidecar spawn is native, not this ACL.
